newsitem.title: USA: Pender County, N.C., plans school bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Pender County, N.C., plans school bond issues.

text.p: North Carolina's Pender County Commission approved a proposal to sell $9 million of general obligation bonds for schools by Dec 31, Wilmington Star-News said Wednesday.

The issue is the first under a $25 million school bond authorization that voters approved in May. The county plans a second issue of $6 million in the spring, and a third issue of $10 million in about two years.

The county had delayed issuing the bonds to assess Hurricane Fran's impact on property tax revenues, which will be used to pay debt service. Although the hurricane destroyed several expensive waterfront homes, County Manager John Bauer said the property tax base was solid enough to proceed with the bond issue.
